title: Extract the uncertain-begin bookkeeping out of engram_host_adapter.rs
outcome: Round-4 review of tm-8b7y (Claude delegation-632eb00d) noted that engram_host_adapter.rs, already far above the module-size threshold, gained ~200 lines of uncertain-begin bookkeeping: detach_engram_pending_dispatch_keeping_uncertain_begin, dropped_engram_intent_grant / record_dropped_engram_intent, ENGRAM_UNCERTAIN_GRANT_UNKNOWN and the stale-begin settlement block. Move them into an engram_uncertain_begin.rs module beside engram_queued_admission.rs as a pure code move (header comment per CLAUDE.md, no behaviour change), mirroring the src/tests/engram_uncertain_begin.rs test module. Land after tm-8b7y; coordinate with tm-4soy (boot-recovery planning extraction) so the two moves do not conflict.
